content: Phase 1: Replace CRA scaffold with Vite + React + TS project (yarn start on port 3000)
Phase 1: Configure Tailwind v4 via @tailwindcss/vite + CSS variables for palette/type/spacing
Phase 1: Self-host Instrument Sans + Martian Mono; strict tsconfig
Phase 1: Data layer — types.ts, money.ts, monogram.ts, date.ts, api/queue.ts + drain timer
Phase 1: Fixtures — 40 customers, 60 items, 3 months of ledger entries (deterministic ISO)
Phase 1: API modules — items, customers, ledger, sales, stock, session (all async, single delay helper)
Phase 2: App shell — bottom nav, sync indicator, skip link, dvh scroll, router with 9 routes + 404
Phase 2: Route / (Till) — search, most-sold grid, running sale, BAYAD, LISTA + customer picker
Phase 2: Route /lista — utang list, payday header state, days-since-last-payment
Phase 2: Route /lista/:customerId — notebook ledger, running balance, RECORD A PAYMENT (append-only)
Phase 2: Route /stock + /stock/:itemId — filters, tingi conversion + live margin
Phase 2: Route /restock — market list, checkable, largest type, estimated total
Phase 2: Motion — only permitted moments, CSS transform/opacity, reduced-motion guard
Phase 2: Typecheck (strict) + production build + zero unused deps verification
Phase 2: End-to-end testing via testing_agent_v3 (mobile 360px viewport, user stories)
